tasks.label: deps
args: arduino-cli core update-index; arduino-cli core install esp32:esp32@3.2.1; arduino-cli lib update-index; arduino-cli lib install "FlixPeriph"; arduino-cli lib install "MAVLink"@2.0.16

tasks.label: Compile
args: $port = (arduino-cli board list | Select-String "esp32:esp32:esp32_family").ToString().Split()[0]; arduino-cli compile --fqbn esp32:esp32:esp32s3:CDCOnBoot=cdc flix

tasks.label: Upload
args: $port = (arduino-cli board list | Select-String "esp32:esp32:esp32_family").ToString().Split()[0]; arduino-cli upload --fqbn esp32:esp32:esp32s3:CDCOnBoot=cdc -p $port flix

tasks.label: Compile and Upload
args: $port = (arduino-cli board list | Select-String "esp32:esp32:esp32_family").ToString().Split()[0]; arduino-cli upload --fqbn esp32:esp32:esp32s3:CDCOnBoot=cdc -p $port flix

tasks.label: Monitor
args: $port = (arduino-cli board list | Select-String "esp32:esp32:esp32_family").ToString().Split()[0]; arduino-cli monitor -p $port -c baudrate=115200
